# rail_trace (Data Source)

Resolves a link hop by hop, as a browser would. Use it in a `check` block to assert that the redirect budget is not exceeded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rail_trace" "quarterly_report" {
  link_id = rail_link.quarterly_report.id
}

# Fail the run if a link drifts out of the browser redirect budget.
check "redirect_budget" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.rail_trace.quarterly_report.headroom >= 2
    error_message = "Link is ${data.rail_trace.quarterly_report.redirects} redirects deep; browsers give up at 20."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `link_id` (String) Id of the link to trace.

### Read-Only

- `gave_up` (Boolean) Whether a browser would have given up.
- `headroom` (Number) Redirects remaining before browsers give up (`ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS`).
- `hops` (Attributes List) Every URL requested, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hops))
- `redirects` (Number) Redirects in the chain.

<a id="nestedatt--hops"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hops`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) Why the hop failed, if it did.
- `instance` (String) RAIL tier that answered, if any.
- `latency_ms` (Number) Time to response.
- `status` (Number) HTTP status; null if the request failed.
- `url` (String) URL requested.
